tools.name: ng_states
tools.description: List all 36 Nigerian states plus the Federal Capital Territory with their capitals. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: ng_phone_lookup
tools.description: $0.003 per call. Normalise a Nigerian phone number (local, +234 or 234 form) and return E.164, line type and network from the prefix allocation. Pay-per-call in USDC over x402.

tools.name: ng_bank_validate
tools.description: $0.003 per call. Validate a 10-digit NUBAN account number against its 3-digit CBN bank code using the check-digit algorithm. Format validation only — does not confirm the account exists.

bank_code.description: 3-digit CBN bank code, e.g. 058 for GTBank

tools.name: ng_identity_format
tools.description: $0.002 per call. Format-validate a Nigerian NIN, BVN, TIN, CAC RC or CAC BN number. Returns validity only — no database lookup and no personal data.

tools.name: chain_networks
tools.description: List the chains this API can read: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, Polygon, with chain ids. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: chain_block_number
tools.description: $0.001 per call. The latest block number on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One or Polygon. Pay-per-call in USDC over x402.

tools.name: chain_balance
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Native-token (ETH/POL) balance of an EVM address, with a USD value at the current spot price.

tools.name: chain_gas
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Current gas price on a chain plus the cost of a plain native transfer, in native token and USD.

tools.name: chain_block
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Block header by number or latest: timestamp, transaction count, gas used, base fee.

tools.name: chain_tx
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Transaction receipt by hash: success/failed status, block, gas used, and the fee in native token and USD.

tools.name: chain_token
tools.description: $0.001 per call. ERC-20 token metadata (symbol, name, decimals) and one holder's balance.

tools.name: sol_networks
tools.description: List Solana networks this API builds for (mainnet-beta, devnet), the on-chain programs used, and the exact rent + fee table for a token launch in lamports. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: sol_launch_plan
tools.description: Free. Validate a Solana token launch before building it: normalises name/symbol/supply/decimals, applies a typed allow/review/deny gate, states the authority policy (mint revoked, no freeze authority by default) and returns the exact on-chain cost in SOL and USD. Use this first — it costs nothing and catches the mistakes that would otherwise be signed.

symbol.description: Token symbol, 1-10 characters, uppercase letters and digits

supply.description: Total supply in UI units as an exact integer string, e.g. "1000000000"

uri.description: https:// or ipfs:// URL of the off-chain metadata JSON (logo and description)

revoke_mint_authority.description: default true — fixed supply, the trust signal buyers screen for

freeze_authority.description: default none — we never set a freeze authority unless asked

tools.name: sol_token_audit
tools.description: $0.003 per call. Read a Solana SPL mint's real authority state: who can mint more supply, who can freeze holders, whether the metadata is immutable, plus on-chain name/symbol/logo and a verdict with machine-readable flags. Reads the chain directly — no opinion, no blacklist.

tools.name: sol_build_launch_tx
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Returns a complete, unsigned Solana transaction that creates an SPL mint, writes Metaplex metadata on-chain, mints the supply to the payer and revokes the mint authority in the same transaction. NON-CUSTODIAL: the service never sees a private key — the caller signs with their own wallet. Requires a payer public key. Test on devnet first.

payer.description: Base58 PUBLIC key of the wallet that pays rent and signs. A private key is never accepted.

symbol.description: Token symbol, 1-10 characters, uppercase letters and digits

supply.description: Total supply in UI units as an exact integer string

uri.description: https:// or ipfs:// URL of the metadata JSON

network.description: mainnet-beta (default) or devnet — devnet costs nothing, try it first

mint_pubkey.description: Supply your own mint public key if you would rather hold that keypair yourself
